derivative.reason: RNF-05: the acquired files named natural persons in their file metadata.
derivative.operation: Person-named metadata fields overwritten with blank filler of identical length.
derivative.scope: Only fields naming a natural person. Software strings (/Creator, /Producer, xmp:CreatorTool, pdf:Producer), document titles and institutional Company values are retained: they are not personal data and they carry publisher provenance.
derivative.why_blanked_not_removed: The DOC file information block addresses 1Table string offsets absolutely. Blanking the strings at identical length preserves those offsets and all stream sizes.
derivative.verification: For both retained DOC files, the original and derivative have the same OLE streams and stream sizes. Only SummaryInformation and 1Table differ; every changed byte lies inside an author/editor metadata string and is replaced by blank filler. WordDocument, Data and all other streams are byte-identical.
derivative.note: The original downloads match the acquisition hashes. published_metadata preserves their source credits and timestamps for attribution outside the documents passed to the system.

method_by_format.doc: Patched in place through the OLE container. Only the SummaryInformation property stream and the 1Table author string tables change; every stream size is preserved and WordDocument and Data are byte-identical.

source_verification.result: Both publisher downloads match acquired_sha256 and acquired_byte_count. Both retained files match stored_sha256 and stored_byte_count.
source_verification.metadata_method: OLE SummaryInformation and DocumentSummaryInformation read with olefile 0.47; text decoded using the declared Windows-1250 code page. The 1Table author/editing strings contain the same two personal credits.
